title: Click Agree
author: Craig Morrow

archive.primary: Craig Morrow - Click Agree - Creative Workshop.html

description:
You walk into a bank with a single purpose but will you be able to go through with it?

Created for a 24 Hour writing challenge at the GDC 2017. Rules of writing were to involve a bank, keep it under six minutes to complete a branch and have at least four branches in screenwriting format.
